texts: The granaries run thin. {{tribeName}} whispers of empty bowls and hungry nights.
Hunger gnaws at the edges of {{tribeName}}'s strength. The stores will not last the moon.
The silos grow hollow. Elders of {{tribeName}} speak of lean times to come.
Famine grips the land. Children cry in the dark. {{tribeName}} faces ruin.
The last grain has been ground. {{tribeName}} is on its knees before starvation.
The granaries overflow. {{tribeName}} feasts beneath a harvest moon.
Abundance blesses the land. {{tribeName}}'s children grow strong and loud.
The old prayers fade. {{tribeName}} begins to doubt the gods.
Doubt creeps through the village of {{tribeName}} like frost through the stones.
The altars of {{tribeName}} stand dusty and untended.
{{tribeName}} has abandoned the old ways. Silence fills the temple.
A wave of holy fervor sweeps {{tribeName}}. Your name is chanted at every hearth.
The faithful of {{tribeName}} have taken to the streets in rapturous song.
{{tribeName}} raises shrines at every crossroads in your honor.
{{tribeName}} worships with undying zeal. Offerings burn day and night in your honor.
{{tribeName}} has grown into a great host. A new generation takes root.
Children fill the halls of {{tribeName}}. The tribe swells with new life.
New voices join the chorus of {{tribeName}} — the tribe grows beyond the elders' memory.
{{tribeName}} spreads across the land. Villages rise where there were once only fires.
{{tribeName}} dwindles to a scattered few. Their songs grow quieter with each passing moon.
Only a remnant of {{tribeName}} survives. Their flame flickers on the edge of darkness.
Your divine power fades to a whisper. The mortal world grows heavy with silence.
The heavens grow dim. {{tribeName}} senses the thinning of divine grace.
Something ancient and heavy weighs on your will. The world turns without you.
Divine energy crackles through you. The heavens bend to your will.
The fields lie scorched and cracked. Not a drop of rain has kissed the earth in many moons.
The rivers spill their banks and swallow the fields whole. {{tribeName}} flees to higher ground.
Parched earth and empty larders. {{tribeName}} prays for rain that does not come.
The soil cracks and the stores fail. {{tribeName}} walks a knife's edge between survival and ruin.
With full bellies and devout hearts, {{tribeName}} stands at the peak of its glory.
A golden age dawns for {{tribeName}}. The gods smile and the granaries overflow.
A great silence falls between {{tribeName}} and the divine. The bond grows fragile.
Something is slipping. {{tribeName}} and the heavens drift apart like smoke on still air.
